title: 美银乔虹：亚洲分化严重，AI与非科技冰火两重天
speaker: Helen Chao

segments.en: Well, it's probably different from the market. I think the market only cares about the AI and the related parafrost sectors.
segments.zh: 这可能与市场看法不同。我认为市场只关心AI及相关领域。

segments.en: But actually for EMAsia, we're looking at basically gross diverging. So the front runners are the tech exports, exporters, such as Taiwan and also Korea, a little bit of Japan and China as well.
segments.zh: 但对于新兴亚洲，我们看到的是严重分化。领先的是科技出口经济体，如台湾、韩国，以及部分日本和中国。

segments.en: But at the same time, we also have the other countries, for example, those in Southeast Asia and in South Asia that struggle a little bit because they are more demand oriented.
segments.zh: 但同时，东南亚和南亚国家则较为挣扎，因为它们更依赖需求。

segments.en: And they also, you know, relies more on imports of energy. And now with oil prices still relatively elevated, hopefully in the near future is coming down a little bit further, they are seeing more struggle in terms of the gross pressure at a time when inflation is about to edge up.
segments.zh: 它们也更依赖能源进口。油价仍相对高位，希望未来会进一步回落，这些国家面临更大的增长压力，同时通胀即将上行。

segments.en: On oil, I mean, what was interesting was how it came out that the oil demand, the imports for China, was not as high as some maybe had expected amid the war.
segments.zh: 关于石油，有趣的是中国石油需求进口并未如一些人在战争期间预期的那么高。
